# Vendored libraries

Unmodified copies from jsdelivr, served by the app so it runs offline.

| Path | Package | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mermaid.min.js` | `mermaid` | 11.4.1 | MIT (`LICENSE-mermaid`) |
| `svg-pan-zoom.min.js` | `svg-pan-zoom` | 3.6.2 | BSD-2-Clause (`LICENSE-svg-pan-zoom`) |
| `layout-elk/` | `@mermaid-js/layout-elk` | 0.1.7 | MIT (`LICENSE-layout-elk`) |

Mermaid and layout-elk must be upgraded together. See "Update the vendored libraries" on the Checks and Docs page of the user guide.
